launch_site: rrtmg_sw_v842.py:350-351 (driver_controls; host readback of the 4 words at 354)
affine_reason: out has no active input, so its state derivative is the constant 0; in the inactive f32 launch scalars it is affine (slope 1/60, rounded once by __fdiv_rn)

args.name: seconds
args.inactive_reason: Model clock xtime_s (call.time_seconds, set on the host each radiation call); not a function of the model state.

args.name: interval
args.inactive_reason: Radiation interval dt_radtsw (namelist constant, 1800 s on hrrrv5).

args.name: out
args.note: words[:2] of driver_controls' 4-word buffer: xtime_m = seconds/60 and radt = interval/60 (minutes); words[2:] belong to mpas_sw_radconst. Its derivative with respect to the state is identically 0 (no active input).

limiters: none: no clamp, min/max or select on a float value (two divisions by the constant 60)

refusal.domain: seconds and interval finite (aug sets failure[0] otherwise)

precondition: out is a 2-word view at offset 0 of driver_controls' 4-word buffer; the entries touch words 0 and 1 only, so mpas_sw_radconst's words 2 and 3 are never written or consumed here
precision: aug: the forward word for word in f32 (__fdiv_rn), built --fmad=false --ftz=false --prec-div=true, bitwise to the forward image. tl: writes +0 to both tangent words (full overwrite). ad: reads and consumes both seeds (sets +0); accumulates into nothing.
binder_roles: deriv.rs roles(): out TL out, AD inout (seed read and consumed in place); no snapshot or clear role; no primal is read by tl/ad.
